title: Three players out for the Fenerbahçe-Kocaelispor match!
text:
Three players out for the Fenerbahçe-Kocaelispor match! SPORTS Three players out for the Fenerbahçe-Kocaelispor match! Three players out for the Fenerbahçe-Kocaelispor match!
 20 November 2026, Friday 13:00 Last Update: 20.11.2026 13:01 Following the break for international matches, Fenerbahçe will face Kocaelispor on the road in the Trendyol Super League tomorrow. The two teams will face off for the 43rd time in the league.

kaynak olarak ekleyin In Week 12 of the Trendyol Super League, Fenerbahçe will face Kocaelispor on the road tomorrow at 7:00 p.m. The Yellow-and-Blues have earned 19 points from 11 league matches—with 6 wins, 1 draw, and 4 losses—and are currently in 6th place. Kocaelispor, sitting in 7th place in the league, has posted the same record during this stretch.Having secured 3 points in their away match against Çorum FK before the international break, the Yellow-and-Blues are looking to win in Kocaeli to kick off a new winning streak. The Green-and-Blacks, meanwhile, have added 7 points to their tally in their last 3 matches.
 43rd League Meeting 
 Read More › 
 Kocaelispor and Fenerbahçe will face off for the 43rd time in the league. In the 42 matches played in league history, the yellow-and-blue team has secured 22 wins, while the green-and-black team has earned 3 points in 7 matches. Thirteen matches ended in a draw. Fenerbahçe scored 76 goals, while Kocaelispor responded with 33.In last season’s matches, the Yellow-and-Blues secured victories with scores of 3-1 at home in Kadıköy and 2-0 on the road.
 Fenerbahçe is undefeated in its last 10 matches 
 In the last 10 matches between Fenerbahçe and Kocaelispor, the Yellow-and-Blues have won 8 times, while 2 matches ended in a draw. The green-and-blacks secured their last victory against their rival on March 27, 1998, winning 2-1 in a home match.Fenerbahçe recorded their most lopsided victories in this rivalry with scores of 5-1 and 4-0. The highest-scoring match between the two sides was a 4-3 victory for Fenerbahçe, recorded on December 27, 1981, at İsmet Paşa Stadium.
 Away Record
 Fenerbahçe has played six away games in the league this season. The Yellow-and-Blues have earned 10 points on the road, defeating Samsunspor, Çaykur Rizespor, and Çorum FK. The Canaries drew 0-0 with Gaziantep FK but lost to Gençlerbirliği and Galatasaray. In these matches, Fenerbahçe found the back of the net 12 times while conceding 4 goals. The Yellow-and-Blues kept a clean sheet in four matches.
 Top-scoring team
 The Yellow-and-Blues have scored 29 goals in 11 matches this season. Fenerbahçe found the back of the net in every match they played, except for the scoreless draw against Gaziantep FK. The Canaries, who hold the title of the league’s top-scoring team, defeated Çorum FK 5-0 in their last match.
 Archie Brown Suspended 
 Read More › 
 Archie Brown, who received a red card during the incidents following the derby against Galatasaray, will not be able to take the field against Kocaelispor. Brown will complete his three-match suspension with this match.Marco Asensio and Nathan Ake are still recovering from injuries and will not be on the roster.
 Kadir Sağlam to Referee 
 Read More › 
 Referee Kadir Sağlam will officiate the match between Kocaelispor and Fenerbahçe. Anıl Usta and Murat Altan will serve as his assistant referees. Alpaslan Şen will be the fourth official.
